+name: Deploy Grammark docs
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [develop]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pages: write
+  id-token: write
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+          cache: npm
+          cache-dependency-path: site/package-lock.json
+      - name: Install deps
+        working-directory: site
+        run: npm install
+      - name: Build site
+        working-directory: site
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: Upload artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
+        with:
+          path: site/dist
+
+  deploy:
+    needs: build
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    environment:
+      name: github-pages
+      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
+        id: deployment
+        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

+# Grammark docs site
+
+This directory contains the Astro Starlight documentation site for Grammark.
+
+## Develop locally
+
+```sh
+cd site
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+## Build
+
+```sh
+cd site
+npm run build
+```
+
+## Publish to GitHub Pages
+
+The GitHub Actions workflow in [.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml](../.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml) publishes the generated site from the `site/dist` directory.

+        { label: 'Specs', autogenerate: { directory: 'specs' } },
+        { label: 'Tutorials', autogenerate: { directory: 'tutorials' } },
+        { label: 'Lab', link: '/lab' },
+      ],
+      customCss: ['./src/styles/custom.css'],
+    }),
+  ],
+});

+---
+title: Overview
+description: Overview of the Grammark project and documentation hub.
+---
+
+Grammark places grammar, documentation, and generated artifacts in one Markdown document. The output contract and the IR schema make the grammar both human-readable and machine-checked.

@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+---
+title: Grammark Docs
+description: Grammars that render themselves.
+---
+
+Grammark is a grammar system whose source format is Markdown. This documentation site bundles the core documentation, formal specs, tutorials, and the future lab experience for grammar authors.
+
+## What you can find here
+
+- Product overview and architecture notes
+- Grammar authoring tutorials
+- Formal grammar and IR specifications
+- The Grammark Lab experience
+
+## Start here
+
+- [Tutorials](/grammark/tutorials/)
+- [Specs](/grammark/specs/)
+- [Lab](/grammark/lab)

@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+---
+title: CST Schema
+description: Notes on the Grammark CST schema and editor/runtime needs.
+---
+
+The CST schema is part of the longer-term runtime roadmap. The playground and the incremental LSP story rely on the same tree representation that the Grammark runtime uses for reliable syntax-tree editing and recovery.

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+---
+title: Grammar Format
+description: Core grammar file format reference for Grammark.
+---
+
+The Grammark grammar format is defined in the [fmt output contract](../../../../docs/fmt-output-contract.md).
+
+The canonical document structure is:
+
+1. one H1 naming the grammar
+2. one H2 per nonterminal
+3. optional precedence and errors sections
+4. generated tables and diagnostics

+description: The Grammark IR schema reference and documentation.
+---
+
+The IR schema is published in [spec/ir-schema.json](../../../../spec/ir-schema.json).
+
+This schema documents the grammar IR contract and the structured table data used by backends and the playground.

+---
+title: Getting Started
+description: Beginner tutorial for Grammark grammar authoring.
+---
+
+This tutorial walks through the basic grammar authoring flow in Grammark, from Markdown structure to generated diagrams and tables.
+
+## Create a grammar file
+
+Use a Markdown file with a single H1 and one H2 per nonterminal.
+
+## Add an lr block
+
+Place productions inside a fenced block beginning with `lr`.
+
+## Verify and format
+
+Run the available Grammark tools to validate the file and emit the generated artifacts.
